title: Does the hallucination probe fail precisely on confident hallucinations?

original_idea.body: Build a hallucination probe; stratify hallucinations by model confidence (logprob) and measure probe recall per bucket to find the confident-fabrication blind spot.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful reliability refinement but hallucination-to-catastrophic-risk chain indirect; gap (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Hallucination probe + confidence stratification on one open model; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (recall vs confidence curve) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public model + benchmarks, externally runnable stratified audit (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Probe + inference, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Hallucination probes exist; confidence-stratified analysis partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Confidence stratification may be partly open.
